result.narrative:
Larsen & Toubro sits in the Watch band with a score of 28.4 (PD 0.1837). Payment behaviour is mild: a single open overdue of 12 days past due against the INR 350M whole-turnover limit, with only one prior overdue on record (resolved 6 days late) and no sign of pileup across the last two six-month windows. News flow is otherwise benign to positive - large new orders, stock rallies, analyst upgrades - except for one recent story.

The Watch banding is driven almost entirely by that one story: a severity-3 regulatory_action headline reporting that a Karnataka minister has asked officials to blacklist L&T over project delays, weighted 20.6 of the 28.4 total score, versus only 7.8 from the payment leg. The adjudicator agreed with the band but added caveats: the payment leg alone would sit comfortably in Healthy, and the news item is a single, headline-only report from one outlet with no corroboration found elsewhere, describing a minister's request rather than a confirmed blacklisting or contract loss.

The recommended action is to maintain the current limit of INR 350,000,000 with no change, as the PD of 0.1837 remains within the 0.25 target appetite and expected loss is unchanged before and after review.

A move to Healthy would need the score to fall 8.4 points below the 20.0 threshold, which would likely follow from the news item decaying (half-life 365 days) or being shown not to have resulted in any real exclusion from tenders, combined with the current overdue clearing promptly. Conversely, the buyer would move toward High Risk (band threshold 50.0) if the regulatory story escalates into an actual blacklist order or contract cancellation, or if payment slips to 38 days past due.

judgement.bottom_line: Recommend maintaining the INR 350,000,000 limit, as PD (0.1837) is within appetite, but flag that the Watch band rests almost entirely on one uncorroborated news headline rather than confirmed deterioration - the adjudicator agreed with caveats on this point.

judgement.news_note: The dominant news driver is a single, uncorroborated Hindu headline reporting a Karnataka minister's request to blacklist L&T over project delays (severity 3, regulatory_action), while all other recent coverage - new orders, stock rallies, analyst upside - is positive or neutral.

The regulatory news item decaying (365-day half-life) or being shown not to have resulted in any actual blacklisting
The current 12-DPD overdue clearing promptly, continuing the clean settlement pattern
